WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_date) AS metric_time__month
    , member_id AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_month_activity" member_month_activity_semantic_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_14.monthly_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_14.monthly_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_8
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_14
ON
  subq_8.metric_time__month = subq_14.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month)
answer: 青禾全门店口径，按完整自然月分别统计（不合并月份）：2026年7月，月内购买会员数11户，月内复购会员数1户，月内复购率为0.0909（约9.09%）；2026年8月，月内购买会员数15户，月内复购会员数12户，月内复购率为0.8000（80.00%）。口径为：月内购买会员数指同一自然月至少有1笔有效订单的会员账户数；月内复购会员数指同一自然月至少有2笔有效订单的会员账户数；月内复购率=月内复购会员数÷月内购买会员数。两个月均非零分母，复购率可直接计算；不同月份人数不能跨月加总。
question: 青禾2026年7月和8月两个完整自然月（2026-07-01含至2026-09-01不含），全门店按月分别列出月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数、月内复购率，不合并月份，复购率保留小数比例。
